test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SLID' is written as 'TMHC', and 'LIST' is written as 'MJRS'. How will 'PILE' be written in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'SLID' is written as 'TMHC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16678efb61c64da8620fe91b7d0ec0bc50a67784c79a74b1a3ba5854ded95bc5.png] 

'LIST' is written as 'MJRS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33a390436164428fdd14f2f8f6395caa2ddaa0ec5d978e2baa29295f12ae9b54.png] 

Similarly, for PILE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d987640a217002f91b6d1985c3e496f60321d09002e7b476b2d2abfaaa943b58.png] 

So, 'PILE' will be written as 'QJKD'.

Hence, the correct answer is "QJKD".
